objective: Add a mechanically-scored expected-information-gain term to the docket ranking as an INPUT alongside the existing gain table, implemented as a keyword rule over a proposal's own pre-declared outcomes, with the lookback evidence attached for the Infra family to verify by hand before it is wired in
rationale: The lookback that tested EIG/core-min against the gain-table heuristic over all 114 closed docket items is filed at the EIG ranking lookback of 2026-08-10 and its verdict was mixed in a way that decides the shape of this proposal. The composite claim FAILED and the chief has recorded the strategy's PROOF clause as NOT MET: ranking by EIG/core-min scored a Spearman correlation of -0.191 against delivered value where the incumbent scored -0.282, which is less wrong rather than right, and neither is a ranking anyone should act on. What passed is the numerator. The information content of a proposal's pre-declared outcomes predicts delivered value at rho +0.311 with p 0.00076 and a top-20 precision of 0.65, against the source-kind gain table's rho +0.118 at p 0.21 and top-20 precision of 0.35. On the 60 items where the cost denominator actually differentiates the separation widens: EIG bits alone rho +0.342 at p 0.007, gain points alone -0.019 at p 0.88. That is why this proposal asks for the numerator only and explicitly does not ask to divide it by anything. The implementation is the version that survived the adversarial pass, and the distinction matters enough to be the whole specification. The hand-assigned tiers in the lookback were assigned by an agent that had already read the outcomes, which is hindsight contamination, so a mechanical keyword rule was written that reads only expected_knowledge_gain and gate and never an outcome: three-outcomes phrasing scores log2(3) bits, an either-or or two-outcomes or both-outcomes or each-outcome-changes or either-way phrasing scores 1.0, a whether phrasing scores 0.811, everything else scores 0.141. That rule reproduces the hand tiers at rho +0.70 while carrying no hindsight, and it keeps the numerator result at rho +0.197 with p 0.035 and a top-20 precision of 0.70, which is HIGHER than the hand version's and double the gain table's. It also loses most of the head-to-head margin, 424 to 241 becoming 357 to 312, and that loss is reported here rather than in a footnote because it is the honest price of removing the hindsight. The mechanical rule is what this proposal asks to implement; the hand tiers are not on offer. Two limits belong in the filing. Zero of the 98 graded predictions in the first calibration scorecard carries a numeric confidence, so the bits are read from an ordinal proxy over the records' own hedging rather than computed from stated probabilities, and the already-filed confidence-line change is what makes the strict version computable next quarter. And the lookback measured one non-monotonicity in the scale itself: the 0.811 tier delivered a mean value of 1.71, below both the 0.469 and 0.141 tiers, on n=7, so this proposal asks for that tier to be merged downward rather than shipped as measured. Axis A: capability-kind at zero solver cost. Axis B: 0. Axis C: 0, and it changes no scored column.

cost_basis: measured; the lookback is already computed and on disk, the rule is a regular-expression scorer over two fields the docket already carries, and verification is a re-run of the published numbers, so no solver time is spent and no case is opened
expected_knowledge_gain: Three outcomes and each decides something different. One: the Infra family reproduces the lookback's numbers with its own hands and the mechanical rule ships as a second ranking input, in which case the docket gains a term that is computed from what a proposal actually pre-declares rather than from what kind of thing it is called, and the gain table stops being the only opinion in the ranking. Two: the family reproduces the numbers and judges rho +0.197 too weak to act on, which is a defensible reading of a p of 0.035 on a single cohort, and the right answer is then to hold the change until the confidence line makes the strict computation available rather than to ship an ordinal proxy into the ranking in force. Three: the family FAILS to reproduce the numbers, which would be the most valuable outcome of the three, because the lookback's grading of 114 outcomes was done by one agent and has never been checked by another, and a grading that does not survive an independent hand is a finding about the lookback rather than about the ranking.
in_sample_verdict: The risk is real and named rather than dismissed. The mechanical rule was written AFTER its author had read the 114 outcomes, so although the rule itself cannot see an outcome, the choice of which phrasings to match was made by someone who could. That is why the proposal's falsifier is a SECOND cohort: the next 50 items closed after this filing, tier-scored by the rule at filing time rather than retrospectively, graded by someone who has not read the lookback. Nothing is fitted, no scored column moves, and no test data is read.
sequencing: Dispatchable now, zero solver cost, Infra family. The rule ships as an ADDITIONAL input and the existing gain table is not removed, because the composite that would have justified replacing it failed its own test. Nothing is rewired until the Infra family has reproduced the lookback's numbers independently, on the S10d and mesh-birth-certificate precedent where the adopting family re-ran the evidence before the standard was adopted.
gate: The Infra family reproduces, from the docket and the lookback script alone, all four headline numbers: mechanical EIG bits vs delivered value rho +0.197 at p 0.035, top-20 precision 0.70, gain points rho +0.118 at p 0.21, top-20 precision 0.35. It then implements the mechanical rule as a scored field beside gain_points, with the 0.811 tier merged into the 0.141 tier per the measured non-monotonicity, and a determinism test of the same shape the existing ranking already carries: same docket in, same scores out. The rule must be shown, by test, to read only expected_knowledge_gain and gate. Adoption is refused if any headline number fails to reproduce.
